study: A fully autonomous robotic ultrasound system for thyroid scanning
rationale: Image quality and anatomy guide repeated probe search, force control and orientation.

study: Towards expert-level autonomous carotid ultrasonography with large-scale learning-based robotic system
rationale: A learned robotic system adapts ultrasound acquisition in participants.

study: Contactless optical coherence tomography of the eyes of freestanding individuals with a robotic scanner
rationale: Tracking and alignment close the acquisition loop; diagnostic next-view selection was not evaluated.

study: Robotic optical coherence tomography retinal imaging for emergency department patients
rationale: Robotic acquisition was clinically evaluated, but classifier output did not drive autonomous reacquisition.

study: Impact of a real-time automatic quality control system for magnetically controlled capsule gastroscopy
rationale: Real-time quality feedback changed operator acquisition rather than directly commanding the capsule.

study: Bimodal tactile tomography with Bayesian sequential palpation
rationale: Bayesian observations select subsequent palpation locations.

study: A minimally invasive robotic tissue palpation device
rationale: The device senses tissue response during robotic palpation; patient diagnostic validation is absent.

study: Automated TMS hotspot-hunting using a closed loop threshold-based algorithm
rationale: Measured motor responses determine subsequent stimulation locations.

study: Efficient TMS-Based Motor Cortex Mapping Using Gaussian Process Active Learning
rationale: Active learning selects subsequent stimulation locations, without prospective robotic clinical integration.

study: Robotic knee laxity testing reliability and normative data
rationale: The standardized force protocol does not adapt its search to current evidence.

study: Development of a Hand Spasticity Testing Device
rationale: Standardized perturbation supports quantitative assessment but not evidence-conditioned action selection.

study: TARGET robotic-assisted bronchoscopy study
rationale: The platform supports navigation and sampling; pathology did not drive autonomous repeat sampling.

study: ADOPT multicentre trial
rationale: Sensing and control support one authorized venipuncture; test results do not authorize repeat puncture.

study: Clinical application of a fully automated blood collection robot
rationale: Automated vessel localization and puncture are evaluated as a bounded acquisition loop.

study: Comparison of swab robot versus manual collection
rationale: Robot sampling is controlled by procedural sensing; laboratory interpretation remains downstream.

study: Autonomous swab robot for naso- and oropharyngeal screening
rationale: A bounded autonomous sampling action retains human loading and sample-handling steps.

study: A robotic biopsy endoscope with magnetic 5-DOF locomotion and retractable biopsy punch
rationale: The platform demonstrates navigation and biopsy acquisition without human validation or adequacy-driven resampling.

study: Ferrobotic swarms enable accessible and adaptable automated viral testing
rationale: Assay state and prevalence assumptions alter physical droplet routing and pooling.

study: All-electronic droplet generation with real-time feedback control
rationale: Closed-loop droplet control is an enabling platform rather than a clinical diagnostic evaluation.

study: SAMPLE autonomous protein engineering
rationale: The system is a closed experimental loop for protein engineering, not patient diagnosis.

study: Apple Heart Study
rationale: A wearable alert prompts confirmatory monitoring; attrition and human execution are part of loop performance.

study: AI-enabled detection using nocturnal breathing
rationale: The study detects disease from passively acquired data without changing acquisition or testing.

study: DETECT-AHEAD
rationale: Wearable signals prompt an at-home diagnostic test that participants must execute.

study: Pre-symptomatic detection from smartwatch data
rationale: Retrospective detection does not execute a diagnostic action.
